name: Carol
source:
A beautiful girl with a strange mood. [url=/c13839]Scrooge[/url]'s partner, having escaped with him from the facility. She is also deemed by the research facility as a "failed product". Carol is the only one who is resistant to the crystallization effect of Scrooge's right hand; however, her Void does not have a definite form, and takes a different shape each time Scrooge draws it out. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Guilty_Crown_characters#Guilty_Crown:_Lost_Christmas]Wikipedia[/url].]
